title: Bontrager Aeolus RSL TLR Road Tire
notes: Official Trek US page read 2026-11-01: US$99.99. RSL TLR construction, 320 TPI cotton casing with sub-tread puncture protection; Race Dual-Compound (61a/50a); semi-slick; tubeless ready/clincher; 'Compatible with hooked and hookless type rims (max pressures vary by size and type)'. 700C x 26 mm 265 g, max 100 psi; 28 mm 285 g, 90 psi; 30 mm 318 g, 80 psi; 32 mm 348 g, 80 psi; sealant 59 ml.
